topics.title: Core Backend Language (Node.js/Go/Python)
topics.description: Python is a high-level, interpreted language known for readability, simplicity, and versatility. Supports multiple paradigms with rich ecosystem including Django/Flask (web), Pandas/NumPy (data), TensorFlow/PyTorch (ML). Used for web development, data science, automation, and scripting.

topics.title: Git & Version Control Workflows
topics.description: Git is a distributed version control system created by Linus Torvalds in 2005. Tracks code changes, enables collaborative development, maintains complete history, and supports branching/merging. Each developer has full repository copy, allowing offline work and robust collaboration.

resources.title: Git & GitHub Crash Course For Beginners

stages.title: Databases & Data Modeling
stages.subtitle: ACID transactions, relational schema and document stores

topics.title: PostgreSQL & Relational Schema Design
topics.description: PostgreSQL is an advanced, open-source RDBMS known for robustness, extensibility, and standards compliance. Supports complex queries, custom data types, full-text search, and ACID properties. Highly extensible with strong concurrency support, suitable for web apps to data warehousing.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Full Course for Beginners – freeCodeCamp
Learn PostgreSQL - Full Tutorial for Beginners

topics.title: Database Indexing, B-Trees & Query Plans
topics.description: Database indexes are data structures that speed up data retrieval by creating references to table data without full table scans. Include B-tree, bitmap, and hash types. Enhance query performance but increase storage requirements and slow down writes due to index maintenance.

resources.title: Use the Index, Luke! - A Guide to Database Performance for Developers

topics.title: NoSQL & Document Stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
topics.description: MongoDB is a NoSQL document-oriented database storing data in BSON format without fixed schemas. Supports horizontal scaling via sharding and high availability through replica sets. Ideal for applications with evolving data structures, real-time analytics, and large-scale data handling.

topics.title: Redis In-Memory Caching & Pub/Sub
topics.description: Redis is an open-source, in-memory data structure store supporting strings, lists, sets, hashes, and sorted sets. Used for caching, session management, real-time analytics, and message brokering. Offers persistence, replication, clustering, and low-latency high-throughput performance.

stages.title: APIs, Authentication & Protocols
stages.subtitle: Robust interface contracts, session management and JWTs

topics.title: RESTful API Design & OpenAPI/Swagger
topics.description: REST API is an architectural style using standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to interact with URI-represented resources. It's stateless, requiring complete request information, uses HTTP status codes, and typically communicates via JSON/XML. Popular for simplicity and scalability.

resources.title: Best practices for RESTful web API design
REST API Best Practices – REST Endpoint Design

topics.title: Authentication, OAuth 2.0 & JWT Security
topics.description: API authentication verifies client identity to ensure only authorized access to resources. Common methods include API keys, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and basic auth. It protects data, prevents unauthorized access, enables usage tracking, and provides granular control over API resources.

topics.title: GraphQL Schemas, Resolvers & Federation
topics.description: GraphQL is Facebook's query language for APIs, allowing clients to request exactly the data they need. Uses a single endpoint with schema-defined data structure, reducing over-fetching and under-fetching. More flexible than REST for complex applications with diverse platform needs. Most servers expose it over HTTP, and the GraphQL over HTTP specification now standardizes the methods, media types and status codes for doing so.

topics.title: gRPC & Protocol Buffers (Protobuf)
topics.description: gRPC is a high-performance, open-source RPC (Remote Procedure Call) framework. Allows programs to execute procedures on remote computers like local functions. Developers don't need to handle remote interaction details, and client/server can use different programming languages.

stages.title: Microservices & Message Queues
stages.subtitle: Asynchronous event streaming and decoupled architectures

topics.title: Message Brokers (RabbitMQ & Apache Kafka)
topics.description: Apache Kafka is a distributed event streaming platform for high-throughput, fault-tolerant data processing. Acts as message broker with publish/subscribe model. Features topics, partitions for parallel processing, and replication for fault tolerance. Ideal for real-time analytics and data integration.

topics.title: Microservices Patterns & Service Mesh
topics.description: Microservices architecture structures applications as loosely coupled, independently deployable services focused on specific business capabilities. Communicate via HTTP or messaging. Enables scalability, flexibility, diverse technologies, and continuous deployment but adds complexity in communication and orchestration.

topics.title: Unit, Integration & Contract Testing
topics.description: Functional testing ensures software meets functional requirements through black box testing. Testers provide input and compare expected vs actual output without understanding source code. Contrasts with non-functional testing (performance, load, scalability).

topics.title: Containerization with Docker
topics.description: Comprehensive technical guide and engineering practices for mastering Containerization with Docker. Explore the curated video tutorials, official documentation, and deep-dive references below to build production competency.

stages.title: Scalability, Cloud & Resiliency
stages.subtitle: Load balancing, rate limiting, and zero-downtime deploys

topics.title: High-Availability System Design
topics.description: Comprehensive technical guide and engineering practices for mastering High-Availability System Design. Explore the curated video tutorials, official documentation, and deep-dive references below to build production competency.

topics.title: Load Balancing & Reverse Proxies (NGINX/Envoy)
topics.description: Nginx is a high-performance web server and reverse proxy known for efficiency and low resource consumption. Also used as load balancer, HTTP cache, and mail proxy. Excels at concurrent connections via asynchronous, event-driven architecture. Popular for modern web infrastructures.

topics.title: Observability, OpenTelemetry & APM
topics.description: Monitoring involves continuously collecting, analyzing, and alerting on metrics, logs, and traces from applications and infrastructure. It helps detect issues early, understand performance bottlenecks, and ensure system reliability. Key tools include Prometheus for metrics collection, Grafana for dashboards and visualization, and distributed tracing tools like Jaeger or Zipkin.

resources.title: Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial for Beginners

topics.title: Cloud Deployments (AWS/GCP/Supabase)
topics.description: AWS Neptune is a fully managed graph database supporting property graph and RDF models. Uses Gremlin and SPARQL query languages for complex relationships in social networks, recommendations, and fraud detection. Offers high availability, multi-AZ replication, and up to 15 read replicas.

resources.title: Setting Up Amazon Neptune Graph Database
